about:
Sparc Welding operates from Boulder City, Nevada. The company is veteran-owned and led by President Damien Federlin. It was founded to address a gap in the custom fabrication market for high-quality work at fair prices backed by communication, reliability, integrity, professionalism, and trust.

The shop provides fabrication and welding, mobile welding (available 24/7), bending and forming, machining, research, design, and engineering, and CNC cutting. It also produces infrastructure components. Scale indicators include 2,862 completed projects, 107 awarded contracts, and 114 international clients; facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers span energy and testing, exotic metals fabrication, industrial systems, aerospace, contracting, and infrastructure component manufacturing. The client base ranges from local neighbors and small businesses to national and international firms and government entities. Named clients include Desert Star Construction, and a testimonial comes from an Air Force representative.

Sparc Welding emphasizes its veteran-owned status, use of quality materials, diversified experience, capable machinery and technology, and efficient turnaround times as differentiators.
